Working hours are flexible between 7am and 7pm. Everyone must be
available for the daily standup at 10am.

Expense reports are submitted in the finance portal before the
5th of each month. Receipts over 50 euros must be attached.

Vacation requests need manager approval at least two weeks in
advance. Unused days do not carry over past March.

The office door code changes on the first Monday of each month.
The new code is posted in the #facilities channel.
